message: New: coins and rewards, in the menu under Tasks. Turn it on and completing a task earns coins, more for bigger tasks and long streaks. Marking a task missed or logging a slip costs coins. Spend them on rewards you set yourself. Pick how often you want a reward and the app suggests a price from how fast you've been earning. There's a list of ideas to start from. A reward can have a note and a link (Uber Eats for takeout, say), be one time only, or be what you're saving for. Items from a list like a wish list can be rewards too, and claiming one checks it off.
